title: Chapter 228
text:
The sticky liquid splashed out, but it could not damage the corrosion-resistant mechanical suit. The Shadow Stalker Viper Beast King's shell cracked open, and blood and sticky liquid leaked out. It looked horrible. After being beaten up by Han Xiao on the ground, its health dropped steadily.

The beasts swarmed forward like crazy. Han Xiao used the Beast King's body as a shield and dodged most of the attacks with his agility. The vision on the tactical display was spinning. Normal people would feel dizzy after just a few glances, but Han Xiao was already used to it and was in good condition.

Every punch and kick carried a tremendous amount of power, and the surrounding terrain was swept away by a hurricane. It was a complete mess.

Viper provided a performance bonus, and his basic combat skills were all maxed out. His melee attack was above average, and the Beast King could not eat waste to recover its health. Its health quickly reached the killing line. Han Xiao channeled his energy, and the Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades circled around his forearm, forming a cone that spun at high speed. Like a drill, it drilled into the Beast King's skull.

The screams were automatically filtered out by him. He grabbed his wound so that he would not be thrown off by the struggling Beast King. He activated the Sunworm and sprayed it at the bloody Beast King's brain. The burnt smell of roasted meat filled the air. The Beast King's body tensed up like a fish on land.

You have killed Shadow Stalker Viper Beast King (LV 53). You have received 132000 EXP.

As soon as the Beast King died, the surrounding Shadow Stalker Vipers roared and charged forward without any fear. They wanted to tear apart this enemy that was harder than steel, and they drowned Han Xiao in an instant.

The next moment, a strong repulsive force spread out, and all the Shadow Stalker Vipers were blown away at a speed that was even faster than killing them. They crashed into the walls of the nest, and the repulsive force field on Viper's gauntlet buzzed.

Rumble!

This repulsive force caused a chain reaction. The nest collapsed section by section, and the shaking of the ground was almost like an earthquake.

Han Xiao did not want to be buried alive. He bent his knees, and the elastic force of his biochemical muscles gathered on his legs. He stepped on the ground and created a large crack. The small maneuvering device spurted out, and with the support of the two forces, he shot up like a rocket. The soil above his head was knocked away, and his helmet made a loud noise, causing his skull to hurt.

In the next second, the road exploded, and a black figure broke out of the ground. His line of sight suddenly opened up, and the night sky hung upside down in his eyes.

The west side of the city collapsed with a rumble. Cracks appeared on the ground, spewing out large amounts of dust. The road sank and collapsed. The scene was extremely grand. Some players were crushed to death, while others managed to escape. They watched this shocking scene in horror.

"The entire city has collapsed. What kind of destructive power is this?!"

"Isn't that Black Phantom? He did it?"

"This battle power is definitely that of a max level boss!"

"All the Shadow Stalker Vipers are buried alive. Does that mean our mission is complete? There doesn't seem to be any notifications. "

The players were bewildered. From time to time, they would glance at Han Xiao, who was wearing a mecha at the side. Their eyes were burning with passion. They had long seen images of mecha battles on the forums. This time, they had finally seen it with their own eyes. It was even more impressive than in videos, so strong that it made them envious.

The revived Jade Green Sky jogged back leisurely. He was shocked by the scene that was beyond recognition. He quickly asked the people beside him. After thinking carefully, he said, "The mission is not over yet. Now is the time to pick up the leftovers."

At the same time, there were signs of biological activity in the ruins. The Shadow Stalker Vipers that were not crushed to death struggled to crawl out. Only a small part of the nest had collapsed, but all the paths were blocked. All the beasts were like turtles in a jar.

Seeing this, the players rushed up to finish off the beasts.

Han Xiao was only responsible for dealing with the Beast Kings. The rest of the monsters were left to the players. He twisted his neck, making cracking sounds to relax his tense nerves.

Huang Yu arrived with his men and waited at the side.

"After the Inhumans clean up all the Shadow Stalker Vipers, you guys excavate the ruins and move all the radiation crystals and corpses into the warehouse. Especially the Beast Kings' corpses. That is a rare material. Although I destroyed many parts of it, it should still be useful," Han Xiao said casually.

Huang Yu glanced at the collapsed ground, swallowed, and nodded hurriedly.

It had only been less than half an hour since they left, and Black Phantom had already solved the problem. Even the West District had collapsed. This efficiency shocked Huang Yu.

Back in his room, Han Xiao took off Viper and repaired some of the damage.

…

After midnight, Huang Yu finally sent news that the ruins had been cleaned up.

"Collected 846 Shadow Stalker Vipers' corpses, including 27 mutants and one Beast King. More than 300 intact eggs have been stored in the cold storage. Other than that, about two tons of radiation crystals have been collected. The three hundred pounds of dark blue crystals in the center of the nest seem to have a higher concentration …

"Oh right, Coney Fury has deduced the cause of the crystals. These Shadow Stalker Vipers feed on high-energy waste and have a special reaction with the mucus secreted in their bodies, hardening and forming crystals …"

Han Xiao was stunned. "So … these radiation crystals are actually the excrement of the Shadow Stalker Vipers?"

"You can say that."

Han Xiao scratched his head and thought of Mad Blade.

Forget it, the truth is too cruel. Better not tell him, I'm afraid he can't take it …

…

The nest was finally cleaned up. The players heaved a sigh of relief and looked at the interface impatiently.

"[Nest Cleaning] completed. Current prize pool: 1.34 million EXP."

"Damage ranking: No. 1 – Jade Green Sky (Team), No. 2 – Red Carp (Team), No. 3 – Don't Sleep During the Day (Team) …"

Those who were on the list were overjoyed. Those who were not on the list were disappointed, but they did not lose out. The EXP from killing the Shadow Stalker Vipers had already filled up the participation fee, so most of them did not lose out.

"We're No. 1!" Jade Green Sky was overjoyed. The core group of people in Sky Territory were jubilant. The players beside them looked over enviously and focused on Jade Green Sky's heavy mechanical arm.

"Sky Territory is still stable."

"What's that equipment of their guild leader? It looks awesome."

"I have a friend who's in their group. That equipment is a Pugilist godly equipment. It can both tank and attack, but it's very expensive. Only Black Phantom sells it."

Seeing the effect of the heavy mechanical arm, the players were filled with desire. Desire gave birth to demand, and demand was a hidden customer.

The ruins needed to be renovated. The person in charge of the West District assigned the work, and the players who had rested for a while participated again.

…

The next day, Han Xiao woke up to the sound of construction in all directions. He rubbed his temples helplessly. He was already used to it. It was indeed very fast to let the players help build the city, but there was a small flaw. The players did not sleep and were working 24 hours a day. This kind of noise pollution almost caused him to have a nervous breakdown.

The secret base had good soundproofing, and it was located in a remote area. Han Xiao went there secretly a few times, hid a lot of resources, and strengthened the defense measures.

On the surface, Han Xiao was not working in the base.

Arriving at the bustling workshop, Han Xiao walked to his own VIP room with ease. The crystals were neatly placed in a few boxes. They were blue, and the halo was like a fog. It was magnificent and beautiful.

However, when he thought about how this thing was the excrement of wild beasts, Han Technician could not appreciate it no matter how beautiful it was. He put on his gloves tighter …

Radiation Crystals, can be turned into energy blocks after purification. Pure energy with no attributes. Although it is said to be high concentration, it should be elementary according to the universe standard. The conversion rate is about 100: 1. Two tons of raw materials can make about 45 pounds of energy blocks, which can be used as emergency energy storage.

This is an unexpected surprise. There were many types of energy: electromagnetic energy, nuclear energy, photon energy, planetary energy, anti-matter energy, dark energy, psionic energy, and so on. If these were psionic energy blocks, he could even buy the entire Blue Star. Unfortunately, only very advanced civilizations could collect, convert, and use psionic energy. Low-level civilizations could not use psionic energy blocks even if they obtained them. Furthermore, civilizations that discovered psionic energy too early basically self-destructed. Studying psionic energy before the technology was mature was suicide, evaporating along with the surface.

There were also 300 pounds of dark blue crystals with a higher concentration. Han Xiao guessed that these were the remains of the excrement of the Beast King. The Beast King occupied the most high-energy waste, so the crystallization rate was the highest, barely reaching medium concentration. The purification rate would be much lower, and it would be able to make about 10 pounds of high-energy Ona energy blocks.

"300 pounds … this guy can really shit." Han Xiao shook his head.

[Elementary Purification] was at max level. The knowledge of the energy branch could be combined to create the Energy Block Purifier, which was a more sophisticated machine. Han Xiao thought for a while and thought of the combination of knowledge. He had a lot of experience, and after a few fusions, he got the blueprint and immediately started to create it.

Two hours later, the creation was successfully completed.

[Basic Energy Block Purifier: Refines minerals and crystals that contain radiation and energy into energy blocks. Conversion rate is average, and speed is low.]

The design of this thing was very magical. The opening was shaped like a funnel, and it could automatically release raw materials. Energy Block Purifiers were the most common in crystal civilizations. Magic and technology coexisted, and energy blocks were the main energy source. Japan's headquarters, Planet Loni, was a crystal civilization. This kind of civilization was a little strange, but the universe was vast, and there were many strange things.

Han Xiao arranged the crystals and set the automatic release. The purification process was automatic, and there was no need to do anything.

"It will take about half a day to completely purify everything. I just have to wait." Han Xiao clapped his hands. There were still corpses and eggs left in the cold storage. Those could be used to make medicine, but he was not a pharmacist.

The Louis Research Institute was in the Western Continent, and it was a little far away. The transportation cost was too expensive, and if it took too long, the materials would lose their activity.

Han Xiao thought for a while and decided to hire a pharmacist.
